description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Obstinate Gargoyle.
When Obstinate Gargoyle dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Obstinate Gargoyle enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Obstinate Gargoyle.
When Obstinate Gargoyle dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Obstinate Gargoyle enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5.
Repeat.
